extraction.notes: All 19 pages read in full (pages 1 and 19 are cover and back matter, page 2 contents and Digital Decade background). This run's items: MDA-IO-2024-002-0016 to MDA-IO-2024-002-0119 (104 items; all theme: TECH-DGOV, TECH-DIGI, TECH-INTEROP, TECH-DATA, TECH-EID, TECH-CYBER, TECH-INFRA and one TECH-AI). Alpha items 0001 to 0015 are unchanged; their passages are quoted again here where in scope. Printed page numbers match the text-file pages. The document is a Commission-funded factsheet prepared by Wavestone with contributions from the Ministry (page 19); much of it describes government systems in promotional language and gives no source or method for its figures, so items record what it states, not whether it is so. Speaker is the publishing observatory throughout; the ministry's contribution is not marked passage by passage, so reported_view is not set. Left out: the Digital Decade background (page 2); the Green SME programme and environmental policies (page 5, not digital); the general statement on the government's commitment to work with the private sector; forecasts and stated benefits (MConnect becoming more valuable, MLog and MCabinet benefits, eFactura advantages, ePrescription benefits, open data portal objectives); the April 2011 Open Data Initiative; the TEN-T transport understanding and the Education Management Information System SIME (sector systems, not digital government); the digital skills, awareness and engagement objectives of the Digital Society Development Programme and the Cybercor cybersecurity education institute (digital skills not linked to an in-scope recommendation); the "no particular initiatives" lines for distributed ledgers, Internet of Things and quantum computing; the GovTech paragraph (restates the MDTS); the subnational line; the Your Europe description (page 18, about EU services, not Moldova). Table rows that only restate a claim already extracted (Open Data Portal, MConnect description, EVO row) are noted on the extracted item. M3 applied: the 60% business services figure (pages 4 and 11) and Law 142/2018 (pages 6 and 8) differ in wording and are extracted at both places; Law 467/2003 is extracted once. No Chapter 2 content: the G2F (foreigners) category of the services portal and the IT park's "labor supply services" are not about workers' rights or access. Doubtful for the analyst (theme_doubtful): the IT sector page (four items), the National Plan, trade facilitation for e-commerce, Law 148/2023 on access to information, the State Register of Controls, MLog as cybersecurity, ePrescription, the Digital Society Development Programme and its devices objective, the big data line, the general emphasis on digitalisation. out_of_window (controlled exceptions for the analyst to confirm): the 2012 MeGIF programme, the 2014-2018 MConnect pilot and the 2012-2014 reuse and open data acts. possible_misread marks words split by the conversion. Second-pass check (PC-05) by checker-HELD8 on 5 November 2026: 4 items added (review/RUN-2026-02/second_pass/MDA-IO-2024-002.csv).

items.stated_text: MPower is a government service launched in 2020 and designed to provide a secure, flexible, and convenient mechanism for managing authorizations for representation.  With MPower, both natural and legal persons can create powers of attorney with an electronic signature, empowering another person to interact on their behalf with state institutions.

items.stated_text: Moldova has taken a significant step towards strenghtening its cybersecurity defenses with the adoption of Law No. 48/2023 on Cybersecurity.
